morilažu: morin — horse; verb-forming -la-, converb -žu, 'mounting' (noun-derived verb, converb) [上馬着]
toγtoγ̇a-beki-ji: Toγtoγ̇a-Beki — Toqto'a Beki, a man's name; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'Toqto'a Beki (object)' (one two-part name + case; Ming 行) [人名 行]
hüldežü: hülde- — to chase, overtake (stem inferred from the Ming 趕); converb -žü, 'chasing' (verb, converb) [趕了]
toγtoγ̇a-jin: Toγtoγ̇a — Toqto'a, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel-final stem, 'of Toqto'a' (personal name + case) [人名 的]
köġün: köġün — son [子] · also read as a collective, 'sons', before a list of several names (Menen-Tudun-(n)u köġün … doloγ̇an, 'seven'; the plural köġüd is the usual form) · also 'lad, young man' (Ming 後生 'junior'), as in köġün küġün 'a young man'
quntuγtai: quntuγ — fortune (a variant of qutuγ; Ming 福); possessive -tai, 'having fortune, fortunate' (noun + possessive, back-vowel form) [福︀ 有的]
ökid: ökin — girl, daughter; plural -d, 'girls' (noun + plural; Ming 女子每) [女子每]
qatud: qatun — lady; plural -d (Ming 婦人(每)) (noun + plural; uncertain: whether it names the girl, 'a lady', or stands as a plural, 'the ladies', is not settled; the Ming has no 'of rank') [婦人(每)] · also 'queens, ladies', plural of a ruler's wives (Ming 娘子每 'the ladies')
qutu: Qutu — Qutu, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
čilaγ̇un: čilaγ̇un — stone (noun) [石] · also Čilaγ̇un, Chila'un, a son's name (personal name; Ming (兒)名)
köġüd-i: köġüd-i — the sons, as object (köġün + plural -d + accusative -i) [子每(行)] · also 'the princes' as object (Ming 大王每(行)), of the Činos princes
irge: irge — wether, castrated ram (noun; Ming 羯羊) [羯羊] · also 'people' (Ming 百姓), a form of irgen, as in tede irge ičuγaγad 'those people, having turned back'
selte: selte — with, bringing along (word uncertain; read from the Ming 帶) [帶]
daγ̇uližu: daγ̇uli- — to plunder; converb -žu, 'plundering' (verb, converb; analysis uncertain, Ming 擄) [擄着] · also written with the Ming 虜著︀ 'taking captive'; the stem daγ̇uli- 'to plunder, take captive'
ber: ber — even, also (particle) [也] · also glossed Ming 裏 'in', where it may rather be the instrumental -ber, 'with' (uncertain)
ese: ese — not (negates a past action; ülü negates present or future) [不曾] · before a converb: ese toγ̇aγdažu 'not yet counted' (as ese ögdegsen 'not given' in §6), where ülü is the usual negative of a converb
ögbe: ög- — to give; past -be, 'gave' (verb, past tense) [與了]
